short.manualReview: Review every final retained row and every wrong or unknown answer; exact configuration-key matching is only an automated lower bound on semantic coverage.

long.scenario: four preconfigured spaces, extended natural developer workload
long.changesFromShortRun: Extended the workload after 48 developer turns naturally remained below 10 KiB; no direct seeding of hot memory, no production code or threshold changes.

reportOnlyChangesAfterExecution: The committed reporter distinguishes recovered test-before-edit failures from incomplete development turns; original recorded violations are retained in results.json.
The committed reporter records the current git revision and harness hashes, redacts fixture roots and credentials throughout the report, and restores its request observer if fixture setup fails.
